repos.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
repos.summary_zh: ECC 是一个面向 AI 智能体的高性能操作框架，专为 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 等主流 AI 编程工具设计。它提供技能管理、本能响应、记忆优化、安全扫描与研究优先的开发模式，支持跨工具统一架构，已在真实产品中经过 10 个月高强度验证。
repos.summary_en: ECC is a high-performance operator system for AI agents, built for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and more. It offers skills, instincts, memory optimization, security scanning, and research-first development, with a cross-harness architecture validated through 10+ months of real-world production use.

repos.description: The agent that grows with you
repos.summary_zh: Hermes Agent 是由 Nous Research 开发的自我改进 AI 智能体，具备内置学习循环：通过经验创建并优化技能、自主记忆管理、跨会话搜索与用户建模。支持多平台接入（Telegram/Slack/Discord等）、任意模型后端切换及服务器less部署，适用于终端交互、自动化任务与研究场景。
repos.summary_en: Hermes Agent is a self-improving AI agent by Nous Research featuring an integrated learning loop: autonomously creates and refines skills from experience, manages memory with periodic nudges, enables cross-session search via FTS5 and LLM summarization, and models user behavior. Supports multi-platform access (Telegram/Slack/Discord), arbitrary model backends, serverless deployment, and research use cases like trajectory generation.

repos.description: Supercharge your AI agents with data from the web and beyond. Building the library for superintelligence. 🔥
repos.summary_zh: Firecrawl 是一个专为 AI 设计的网页数据 API，可将任意网站转换为 LLM 可直接使用的结构化数据（如 Markdown、JSON、截图等），支持 JavaScript 渲染、动态内容抓取、批量处理和内容变更监控，显著提升 AI 应用的数据获取效率与准确性。
repos.summary_en: Firecrawl is a web data API designed for AI, converting any website into LLM-ready structured data (e.g., Markdown, JSON, screenshots). It supports JavaScript rendering, dynamic content extraction, batch processing, and change tracking, significantly enhancing data acquisition for AI applications.

repos.description: The agent engineering platform.
repos.summary_zh: LangChain 是一个构建可靠 AI 智能体的框架，提供标准化的 LLM、嵌入、向量存储等组件接口，支持实时数据增强、模型互操作性和快速原型开发，助力开发者高效构建生产级 LLM 应用。
repos.summary_en: LangChain is a framework for building reliable AI agents and LLM-powered applications. It offers standardized interfaces for models, embeddings, and vector stores, enabling real-time data augmentation, model interoperability, and rapid prototyping for production-ready AI solutions.

repos.description: 利用 AI 大模型和自动化工作流，根据主题或关键词一键生成高清短视频。Generate HD short videos from a topic or keyword with an automated AI workflow.
repos.summary_zh: MoneyPrinterTurbo 是一款基于 AI 大模型的智能短视频生成工具，支持一键生成高清横竖屏视频。用户只需输入主题或关键词，即可自动完成文案生成、素材匹配、语音合成、字幕添加及背景音乐配置，全面覆盖视频创作流程，支持多模型接入与批量处理，适用于内容创作者快速产出高质量短视频。
repos.summary_en: MoneyPrinterTurbo is an AI-powered short video generation tool that leverages large language models to automatically create high-definition videos with one click. Users input a topic or keyword to generate scripts, visuals, voiceovers, subtitles, and background music. It supports multiple AI models, batch processing, and both vertical and horizontal formats, ideal for content creators seeking efficient video production.

repos.description: Agents that use the browser.
repos.summary_zh: Browser-Use 是一个专为 AI 智能体设计的网页自动化框架，通过 LLM 驱动浏览器完成复杂在线任务。支持主流大模型（Gemini、Claude 等），提供 stealth 模式云浏览器服务，实现高效、隐蔽的网页交互与数据采集，适用于自动化测试、信息抓取等场景。
repos.summary_en: Browser-Use is an AI agent framework that enables LLM-driven automation of web tasks. It supports major LLMs (Gemini, Claude, etc.) and offers stealth cloud browsers for secure, scalable automation. Ideal for web scraping, testing, and data collection with seamless integration.

repos.description: AI agents running research on single-GPU nanochat training automatically
repos.summary_zh: Karpathy 提出的 AI 自主研究系统，让 AI agent 在单 GPU 上自动修改训练代码、执行 5 分钟实验并迭代优化模型。通过 program.md 编程 agent 行为，实现 overnight 自动化 LLM 训练研究，无需人工干预即可探索架构与超参优化。
repos.summary_en: An autonomous AI research system by Karpathy where agents automatically modify training code, run 5-minute experiments on a single GPU, and iterate to optimize LLMs. Researchers program agent behavior via program.md, enabling overnight self-directed model training research without manual intervention.

repos.description: Open-source web crawler and scraper for LLMs and AI agents: any website into clean, LLM-ready Markdown. Run it yourself, or use Crawl4AI Cloud with one key.
repos.summary_zh: Crawl4AI 是一个开源的 LLM 友好型网络爬虫与抓取工具，专为将网页转换为干净、适合大语言模型（LLM）处理的 Markdown 格式而设计，广泛应用于 RAG、智能体和数据流水线场景。其核心亮点包括高吞吐量、可控性强、支持 Docker 部署，并具备崩溃恢复、预抓取加速等高级功能，拥有 5 万+ GitHub 星标社区。
repos.summary_en: Crawl4AI is an open-source, LLM-friendly web crawler and scraper that converts web pages into clean, LLM-ready Markdown for RAG, agents, and data pipelines. It features high throughput, Docker support, crash recovery, prefetch mode for 5-10x faster URL discovery, and is battle-tested by a 50k+ star community. Ideal for scalable, cost-effective web extraction.

repos.description: Transforms complex documents like PDFs and Office docs into LLM-ready markdown/JSON for your Agentic workflows.
repos.summary_zh: MinerU 是一款高效文档解析工具，可将 PDF 等复杂文档自动转换为 LLM 友好的结构化输出（Markdown/JSON），显著提升 Agentic 工作流的文档处理效率与数据可用性。
repos.summary_en: MinerU is a high-performance document parsing tool that transforms complex documents like PDFs into LLM-ready structured outputs (Markdown/JSON), significantly enhancing document processing efficiency and data accessibility for agentic workflows.

repos.description: 为GPT/GLM等LLM大语言模型提供实用化交互接口，特别优化论文阅读/润色/写作体验，模块化设计，支持自定义快捷按钮&函数插件，支持Python和C++等项目剖析&自译解功能，PDF/LaTex论文翻译&总结功能，支持并行问询多种LLM模型，支持chatglm3等本地模型。接入通义千问, deepseekcoder, 讯飞星火, 文心一言, llama2, rwkv, claude2, moss等。
repos.summary_zh: GPT Academic 是为 GPT/GLM 等 LLM 大语言模型设计的实用化交互接口，专注论文阅读、润色与写作优化，支持模块化插件与自定义快捷按钮，集成 Python/C++ 项目剖析、PDF/LaTeX 论文翻译与总结功能，兼容通义千问、DeepSeek、文心一言等主流模型，支持本地部署与多模型并行调用。
repos.summary_en: GPT Academic is a practical interface for GPT/GLM and other LLMs, optimized for academic tasks like paper reading, editing, and writing. It features modular plugins, custom shortcuts, code analysis, PDF/LaTeX translation, and supports multiple models including Qwen, DeepSeek, and local deployments like ChatGLM3.

repos.description: Stop renting your intelligence. Own it with AnythingLLM. Everything you need for a powerful local-first agent experience
repos.summary_zh: AnythingLLM 是一款全栈式桌面与 Docker AI 应用，集成 RAG、AI 智能体、无代码智能体构建器及 MCP 兼容性，支持多用户管理与权限控制，提供灵活 LLM 与向量数据库配置，实现文档智能对话与自动化处理。
repos.summary_en: AnythingLLM is a full-stack desktop and Docker-based AI application featuring built-in RAG, AI agents, no-code agent builder, and MCP compatibility. It supports customizable LLMs and vector databases, multi-user management, and seamless document interaction for intelligent chat and automation.

repos.description: LlamaIndex is the document processing platform for AI
repos.summary_zh: LlamaIndex 是一个领先的文档智能代理与 OCR 平台，专为构建基于大模型的文档应用而设计。它提供数据连接、索引、查询与可视化能力，支持多模态输入与复杂推理，广泛应用于知识库问答、文档分析与智能检索等场景。
repos.summary_en: LlamaIndex is a leading document agent and OCR platform designed for building LLM-powered document applications. It enables data ingestion, indexing, querying, and visualization, supporting multimodal inputs and complex reasoning for use cases like knowledge base QA, document analysis, and intelligent retrieval.

repos.description: Open-source personal AI assistant & Agent Harness. Plans tasks, runs tools and skills, self-evolves with memory and knowledge. Multi-agent, multi-model, multi-channel. Lightweight, extensible, one-line install.
repos.summary_zh: CowAgent 是基于大模型的超级 AI 助理，具备自主任务规划、长期记忆、个人知识库和技能系统能力。支持多模态交互（文本/语音/图片/文件），兼容 OpenAI、Claude、DeepSeek 等主流模型，可接入微信、飞书、钉钉等多平台，提供 CLI 管理和 Web 控制台，适用于个人 AI 助理和企业数字员工场景。
repos.summary_en: CowAgent is a super AI assistant based on large language models, featuring autonomous task planning, long-term memory, personal knowledge base, and skill system. It supports multimodal interactions (text/voice/image/file), integrates with OpenAI/Claude/DeepSeek and other mainstream models, connects to WeChat/Lark/DingTalk and other platforms via CLI/Web console, ideal for personal AI assistants and enterprise digital employees.

repos.description: 免费大模型API，支持免费调用GPT、DeepSeek等主流模型，免费额度10000点，每日刷新！另付费价格最低官方1-2折！
repos.summary_zh: ChatAnywhere 提供免费 ChatGPT 和 DeepSeek API 转发服务，支持 gpt-5、gpt-4o、deepseek-r1/v3、claude、gemini、grok 等主流大模型。采用 OpenAI 标准协议，兼容各类应用，支持流式响应，国内直连无需代理，免费额度每日 200 次（按 IP 和 Key 共享），适合个人非商业用途。
repos.summary_en: ChatAnywhere offers free ChatGPT and DeepSeek API key forwarding services, supporting top-tier models like gpt-5, gpt-4o, deepseek-r1/v3, claude, gemini, and grok. It uses the official OpenAI-compatible protocol, supports streaming responses, and enables direct access from China without proxies. Free tier allows 200 requests/day per IP+Key combination for personal non-commercial use.

repos.description: CowAgent是基于大模型的超级AI助理，能主动思考和任务规划、访问操作系统和外部资源、创造和执行Skills、拥有长期记忆并不断成长，比OpenClaw更轻量和便捷。同时支持微信、飞书、钉钉、企微、QQ、公众号、网页等接入，可选择OpenAI/Claude/Gemini/DeepSeek/ Qwen/GLM/Kimi/LinkAI，能处理文本、语音、图片和文件，可快速搭建个人AI助理和企业数字员工。
repos.summary_zh: CowAgent 是基于大模型的超级AI助理，支持主动任务规划、多模态交互（文本/语音/图片/文件）、长期记忆与技能系统，可接入飞书、钉钉、企业微信、微信公众号等多平台，兼容OpenAI/Claude/Gemini/DeepSeek等主流模型，适用于个人AI助手与企业数字员工场景。
repos.summary_en: CowAgent is a super AI assistant based on large language models, supporting autonomous task planning, multimodal interaction (text/audio/image/files), long-term memory, and a skill system. It integrates with platforms like Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom, and WeChat Official Accounts, compatible with OpenAI/Claude/Gemini/DeepSeek models, ideal for personal AI assistants and enterprise digital employees.

repos.description: Langchain-Chatchat（原Langchain-ChatGLM）基于 Langchain 与 ChatGLM, Qwen 与 Llama 等语言模型的 RAG 与 Agent 应用 | Langchain-Chatchat (formerly langchain-ChatGLM), local knowledge based LLM (like ChatGLM, Qwen and Llama) RAG and Agent app with langchain
repos.summary_zh: Langchain-Chatchat 是基于 Langchain 框架的开源本地知识库问答系统，支持 ChatGLM、Qwen、Llama 等主流开源大模型，提供 RAG（检索增强生成）与 Agent 应用能力。项目支持离线部署，兼容多种向量数据库与 Embedding 模型，具备 FastAPI 接口与 Streamlit WebUI，适用于私有化部署的文档问答与智能助手场景。
repos.summary_en: Langchain-Chatchat is an open-source local knowledge base QA system built on the Langchain framework, supporting mainstream open-source LLMs like ChatGLM, Qwen, and Llama. It provides RAG and Agent capabilities with offline deployment, compatibility for various vector databases and embedding models, and offers both FastAPI endpoints and a Streamlit WebUI for document-based Q&A and intelligent assistant applications.

repos.description: OpenAssistant is a chat-based assistant that understands tasks, can interact with third-party systems, and retrieve information dynamically to do so.
repos.summary_zh: Open Assistant 是一个开源的聊天式AI助手项目，旨在提供可交互、可集成第三方系统的语言模型服务。项目已完成，核心贡献是构建并发布了 oasst2 高质量对话数据集，推动开放语言模型发展。
repos.summary_en: Open Assistant was an open-source chat-based AI assistant project designed to provide accessible, interactive large language model capabilities with third-party system integration. The project is now completed, with its final oasst2 dataset published on HuggingFace, marking a significant contribution to open-source language model training data.

repos.description: ⌥ Coding agent with the IDE wired in. Built by Stencil Labs.
repos.summary_zh: oh-my-pi 是一款功能强大的终端 AI 编程代理，内置 31 种工具和 60+ 大模型支持。采用 Rust 核心构建，支持 LSP/DAP 操作、哈希锚定编辑与子代理协同，为开发者提供类 IDE 的智能编码体验。
repos.summary_en: oh-my-pi is a powerful terminal-based AI coding agent featuring 31 built-in tools and 60+ LLM providers. Built on a Rust core (~80k lines), it supports LSP/DAP operations, hash-anchored edits, and subagent orchestration, delivering IDE-grade intelligent coding directly in the terminal.

repos.summary_zh: TaskMatrix 通过连接 ChatGPT 与一系列视觉基础模型，实现聊天中发送和接收图像。其核心创新在于引入模板机制，将人类经验转化为多模型协作的预定义执行流，支持图像编辑、目标检测、语义分割等复杂视觉任务，无需额外训练即可实现跨模型协同。
repos.summary_en: TaskMatrix connects ChatGPT with visual foundation models to enable image sending/receiving during chat. It introduces a template mechanism—pre-defined execution flows that leverage human expertise to orchestrate complex multi-model tasks like image editing, object detection, and segmentation, enabling seamless collaboration without additional training.

repos.description: Open-source LLM knowledge platform: turn raw documents into a queryable RAG, an autonomous reasoning agent, and a self-maintaining Wiki.
repos.summary_zh: WeKnora 是腾讯开源的 LLM 驱动文档理解与检索框架，基于 RAG 范式实现深度语义检索与上下文感知回答。支持多模态预处理、向量索引、智能检索及自定义 Agent，提供知识库管理、API 认证、K8s 部署等能力，适用于复杂异构文档的智能问答场景。
repos.summary_en: WeKnora is an LLM-powered framework for deep document understanding and semantic retrieval using the RAG paradigm. It features modular architecture with multimodal preprocessing, vector indexing, intelligent retrieval, and custom agents. Supports knowledge base management, API authentication, K8s deployment, and advanced features like thinking mode and data analysis.

repos.description: 7.4 billion tokens per month. 34 free LLM providers. 635 free model endpoints. All behind one /v1 endpoint, plus any custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Smart routing, automatic failover, encrypted keys. Personal experimentation only.
repos.summary_zh: FreeLLMAPI 是一款聚合 16 家主流 AI 厂商免费额度的 OpenAI 兼容代理网关。它通过单一 /v1 端点提供约 1.7 亿 Token/月的算力，具备智能路由、自动故障转移和加密密钥存储功能，旨在解决多 SDK 调用复杂和额度分散的痛点，适合个人开发者进行低成本 AI 实验。
repos.summary_en: FreeLLMAPI is an OpenAI-compatible proxy aggregating free tiers from 16 major LLM providers into a single /v1 endpoint, delivering ~1.7B tokens/month. It features smart routing, automatic failover, and encrypted key storage, eliminating the complexity of managing multiple SDKs and scattered quotas for personal AI experimentation.

repos.description: FastGPT is a knowledge-based platform built on the LLMs, offers a comprehensive suite of out-of-the-box capabilities such as data processing, RAG retrieval, and visual AI workflow orchestration, letting you easily develop and deploy complex question-answering systems without the need for extensive setup or configuration.
repos.summary_zh: FastGPT 是一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的知识型 AI 智能体构建平台，提供开箱即用的数据处理、RAG 检索、可视化 AI 工作流编排等功能，支持复杂问答系统的快速开发与部署，无需繁琐配置。
repos.summary_en: FastGPT is a knowledge-based AI agent platform built on LLMs, offering out-of-the-box capabilities such as data processing, RAG retrieval, and visual AI workflow orchestration. It enables rapid development and deployment of complex question-answering systems without extensive setup.

repos.description: A simple screen parsing tool towards pure vision based GUI agent
repos.summary_zh: OmniParser 是一个面向纯视觉 GUI 代理的屏幕解析工具，通过将界面截图结构化解析为可理解的元素，显著提升 GPT-4V 等视觉模型在界面区域精准定位和交互的能力。支持图标检测与功能描述，集成 OmniTool 实现 Windows 11 虚拟机控制，兼容多种大语言模型，适用于自动化操作与训练数据生成。
repos.summary_en: OmniParser is a screen parsing tool designed for pure vision-based GUI agents, transforming UI screenshots into structured elements to enhance the accuracy of vision models like GPT-4V in grounding actions. It supports icon detection, interactivity prediction, and integrates with OmniTool for Windows 11 VM control, compatible with OpenAI, DeepSeek, Qwen, and Anthropic models for automation and training data generation.

repos.description: A gallery that showcases on-device ML/GenAI use cases and allows people to try and use models locally.
repos.summary_zh: Google AI Edge Gallery 是一个展示端侧机器学习与生成式 AI 应用的实验性应用，支持在 Android 和 iOS 设备上本地运行大模型，提供离线聊天、图像问答、音频转录、提示工程等功能，并集成 Tiny Garden 小游戏与设备控制能力，实现完全离线的智能体验。
repos.summary_en: Google AI Edge Gallery is an experimental app showcasing on-device ML/GenAI use cases, enabling users to run generative AI models locally on Android and iOS. It supports offline chat, image Q&A, audio transcription, prompt engineering, and includes a mini game and device control via fine-tuned models, all without requiring an internet connection.

repos.description: 面向开发者的 LLM 入门教程，吴恩达大模型系列课程中文版
repos.summary_zh: 本项目是面向开发者的 LLM 入门教程，基于吴恩达大模型系列课程打造，覆盖 Prompt Engineering、RAG、模型微调等全流程。内容涵盖从基础 API 调用到 LangChain 应用开发，提供中文复现代码与 Prompt 优化方案，支持 Jupyter Notebook 实践，助力开发者快速掌握 LLM 应用开发技能。
repos.summary_en: This project is a developer-focused LLM入门教程 based on Andrew Ng's large language model courses, covering Prompt Engineering, RAG, and fine-tuning. It includes translated, reproduced code examples and optimized Chinese prompts, enabling hands-on learning via Jupyter Notebooks to help developers master LLM application development.

repos.description: Universal provider proxy for OpenAI Codex & Claude Code — use any LLM (Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Ollama…) with Codex CLI, App, SDK, and Claude Code
repos.summary_zh: OpenCodex 是一款通用的本地代理工具，旨在打破 OpenAI Codex 与 Claude Code 对特定大模型的限制。它通过将 Codex 的 Responses API 转换为任意 LLM 提供商（如 Claude、Gemini、DeepSeek、Ollama 等）的接口，实现无缝切换。该工具支持流式传输、工具调用及多模态输入，并内置了 ChatGPT 账号池管理功能，可自动进行配额刷新与负载均衡，确保开发流程的连续性。
repos.summary_en: OpenCodex is a universal local proxy that eliminates vendor lock-in for OpenAI Codex and Claude Code. It translates Codex's Responses API into various LLM provider formats (Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Ollama, etc.), enabling seamless model switching. Supporting streaming, tool calls, and multimodal inputs, it also features a ChatGPT account pool manager for automatic quota refreshing and load balancing to ensure uninterrupted development workflows.

repos.description: High-Quality Voice Cloning TTS for 600+ Languages
repos.summary_zh: OmniVoice 是一款支持 600+ 语言的零样本语音克隆 TTS 模型，采用扩散语言模型架构，实现高质量语音生成与快速推理（RTF 低至 0.025）。支持语音克隆、音色设计、非语言符号控制及多语言发音修正，适用于跨语言语音合成、虚拟配音、多语言内容创作等场景。
repos.summary_en: OmniVoice is a state-of-the-art zero-shot TTS model supporting 600+ languages with diffusion language model architecture. It delivers high-quality voice cloning, voice design, and fast inference (RTF 0.025), enabling multilingual speech synthesis for content creation, virtual dubbing, and voice AI applications.

repos.description: Self-evolving memory OS for LLM & AI Agents: ultra-persistent memory, hybrid-retrieval, and cross-task skill reuse, with 35.24% token savings and DeepSeek Harness support.
repos.summary_zh: MemOS 2.0（星尘）是一个专为 LLM 和智能体系统设计的 AI 记忆操作系统，支持跨任务技能记忆的持久化存储与进化。通过混合检索机制（FTS5 + 向量搜索）实现高效记忆管理，显著降低 token 消耗（节省35.24%），并在 LongMemEval、PrefEval-10 等基准测试中表现优异。提供云端与本地两种部署模式，兼容 OpenClaw 等多智能体框架，支持技能复用与协作。
repos.summary_en: MemOS 2.0 (Stardust) is an AI memory OS designed for LLM and agent systems, enabling persistent skill memory across tasks with reuse and evolution. It combines FTS5 and vector search for hybrid retrieval, reducing token usage by 35.24% while achieving top-tier performance on benchmarks like LongMemEval (+40.43%) and PrefEval-10 (+2568%). Supports cloud and local deployment modes, integrates with multi-agent frameworks like OpenClaw, and enables skill sharing and collaboration.

repos.description: Spark-TTS Inference Code
repos.summary_zh: Spark-TTS 是基于 Qwen2.5 大语言模型的高效文本转语音系统，支持中英双语及零样本语音克隆，具备可控语音生成能力。其核心创新在于单流解耦语音标记与 LLM 直接预测音频编码，无需额外声学模型，显著提升推理效率并降低部署复杂度，适用于多语言场景下的语音合成与跨语言迁移。
repos.summary_en: Spark-TTS is an efficient LLM-based text-to-speech model using Qwen2.5 for high-quality, bilingual (Chinese/English) speech synthesis. It supports zero-shot voice cloning and controllable generation (e.g., gender, pitch) with a single-stream decoupled architecture that directly reconstructs audio from LLM-predicted tokens, eliminating the need for separate acoustic models and enabling cross-lingual applications.

repos.description: Automate your mobile devices with natural language commands - an LLM agnostic mobile Agent 🤖
repos.summary_zh: Mobilerun 是一个强大的移动端自动化框架，支持通过自然语言命令控制 Android 和 iOS 设备。它基于 LLM 代理技术，提供多步骤任务规划、截图分析和跨平台支持，兼容 OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini 等多种大模型，适用于复杂设备交互自动化场景。
repos.summary_en: Mobilerun is a powerful framework for controlling Android and iOS devices via natural language commands using LLM agents. It supports multi-step task planning, screenshot analysis, and works with multiple LLM providers like OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini, enabling complex mobile automation through visual understanding.

repos.description: LangChain 的中文入门教程
repos.summary_zh: LangChain 中文入门教程系统讲解大模型应用开发框架，涵盖文档加载、文本分割、向量存储、Chain 链与 Agent 代理等核心概念，提供 OpenAI API 集成、PDF/YouTube 数据处理等实战案例，配套 GitBook 与 Colab 代码，适合 AI 开发者快速上手构建智能应用。
repos.summary_en: This comprehensive LangChain Chinese tutorial covers core concepts like document loading, text splitting, vectorstores, chains, and agents for building LLM-powered applications. It includes practical examples with OpenAI integration, PDF/YouTube data processing, and provides GitBook and Colab code resources for developers to quickly build AI applications.

repos.description: 🧑‍🚀 全世界最好的LLM资料总结（多模态生成、Agent、辅助编程、AI审稿、数据处理、模型训练、模型推理、o1 模型、MCP、小语言模型、视觉语言模型） | Summary of the world's best LLM resources.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库是全网最全面的大语言模型（LLM）资源汇总，涵盖多模态生成、Agent、辅助编程、AI审稿、数据处理、模型训练与推理等全链路技术方向，持续更新维护，为研究者与开发者提供权威的一站式学习与实践指南。
repos.summary_en: This repository is the most comprehensive collection of LLM resources globally, covering multimodal generation, agents, code assistance, AI review, data processing, model training and inference, and more. It serves as an authoritative one-stop guide for researchers and developers, continuously updated.

repos.description: Self-hosted multi-protocol AI API proxy for Antigravity, Codex, Grok, Kiro, OpenAI, Claude, and custom providers. Supports OpenAI-compatible API, Claude API, Gemini protocol conversion, GPT, Grok Build, Claude Opus, Gemini Pro, Kimi, MiniMax, provider pools, smart routing, and automatic failover.
repos.summary_zh: AIClient2API 是一个强大的代理工具，可将 Gemini CLI、Antigravity、Codex、Grok 和 Kiro 等仅客户端大模型 API 的请求统一封装为本地 OpenAI 兼容接口，支持每日数千次 Gemini 请求，并免费使用 Kiro 内置 Claude 模型，极大提升 AI 开发效率。
repos.summary_en: AIClient2API is a powerful proxy that unifies client-only LLM APIs (Gemini CLI, Antigravity, Codex, Grok, Kiro) into a local OpenAI-compatible interface. It supports thousands of daily Gemini requests and offers free access to Kiro's built-in Claude model, streamlining AI development.

repos.description: Automate your mobile devices with natural language commands - an LLM agnostic mobile Agent 🤖
repos.summary_zh: DroidRun 是一个强大的移动端自动化框架，通过 LLM 智能体实现自然语言控制 Android 和 iOS 设备。支持多模型提供商（OpenAI、Anthropic 等），具备复杂任务规划能力，提供 CLI 工具和 Python API，集成截图分析与执行追踪，实现高效移动端自动化。
repos.summary_en: DroidRun is a powerful framework for controlling Android and iOS devices via LLM agents using natural language commands. It supports multiple LLM providers, offers planning capabilities for complex tasks, includes a CLI tool with debugging features, and integrates screenshot analysis and execution tracing for mobile automation.

repos.description: 🔥 基于大模型和 RAG 的智能问数系统，对话式数据分析神器。Text-to-SQL Generation via LLMs using RAG.
repos.summary_zh: SQLBot 是基于大语言模型和 RAG 技术的智能问数系统，支持对话式数据分析（ChatBI），实现自然语言转 SQL 查询并生成可视化图表。具备开箱即用、安全可控、易于集成等优势，可嵌入 DataEase、Dify 等应用，支持细粒度权限管理与持续优化，越问越准。
repos.summary_en: SQLBot is an intelligent data querying system powered by LLMs and RAG, enabling conversational analytics (ChatBI) with natural language-to-SQL conversion and visualization. It offers plug-and-play deployment, secure workspace isolation, fine-grained permissions, and seamless integration into platforms like DataEase and Dify, continuously improving accuracy through user interactions.

repos.description: 一个自己找热点、自己写日报的网站框架。把信源和精选标准换成你的，它就是你的行业热点站。
repos.summary_zh: AIHOT 是一个开源的行业热点监测框架，自动从多源采集资讯，经大模型预筛、双评分与去重聚簇，生成中文标题、摘要与日报/周报/月报，支持 RSS、X、微信公众号等信源，可快速部署为法律、金融、HR 等垂直领域的智能热点站。
repos.summary_en: AIHOT is an open-source framework for industry-specific news aggregation. It auto-collects from RSS, web, X and WeChat, applies AI pre-filtering, dual scoring and event clustering, then generates Chinese headlines, summaries and daily/weekly/monthly reports. Deployable as a vertical hotspot dashboard for legal, financial, HR domains.

repos.description: FunASR-powered video transcription, subtitle generation, and LLM-assisted clipping tool with a local Gradio UI.
repos.summary_zh: FunClip 是一款开源、精准且易用的视频语音识别与剪辑工具，集成阿里巴巴通义语音实验室开源的 FunASR Paraformer 系列模型，支持中文及英文语音识别，具备热词定制、说话人分离、多段自由剪辑等功能，并引入 LLM 智能剪辑能力，用户可通过 Gradio 界面快速生成精准视频片段与字幕。
repos.summary_en: FunClip is an open-source, accurate, and user-friendly video speech recognition and clipping tool. It leverages Alibaba's FunASR Paraformer models for ASR, supports Chinese and English, enables hotword customization, speaker separation, multi-segment clipping, and integrates LLM-based AI clipping via Qwen/GPT series models with customizable prompts for intelligent video editing.

repos.description: ⚡️next-generation personal AI assistant powered by LLM, RAG and agent loops, supporting computer-use, browser-use and coding agent, demo: https://demo.openagentai.org
repos.summary_zh: OpenAgent 是一款开源的企业级 AI 知识库与智能体管理平台，支持 MCP/A2A 协议，集成 ChatGPT、Claude、Llama 等主流大模型，提供带单点登录的管理后台和用户界面，适用于构建私有化 AI 应用与多智能体协作系统。
repos.summary_en: OpenAgent is an open-source enterprise-grade AI knowledge base and agent management platform supporting MCP/A2A protocols. It integrates major LLMs like ChatGPT, Claude, and Llama, offering admin UI, user management, and SSO for secure, scalable AI application deployment.

repos.description: Repo for BenCao [original name: HuaTuo (华驼)], Instruction-tuning Large Language Models with Chinese Medical Knowledge. 本草（原名：华驼）模型仓库，基于中文医学知识的大语言模型指令微调
repos.summary_zh: 本草（原名华驼）开源基于中文医学知识指令微调的LLaMA、Alpaca-Chinese、Bloom、活字等模型，采用LoRA方法在医学知识库与文献数据上训练，显著提升医疗问答效果，支持多基模型适配与推理部署。
repos.summary_en: BenTsao (formerly HuaTuo) is an open-source collection of instruction-tuned large language models including LLaMA, Alpaca-Chinese, Bloom, and Huozi, fine-tuned on Chinese medical knowledge using LoRA. It enhances medical Q&A performance across multiple base models with support for inference deployment.

repos.description: 🚀 KIMI AI 长文本大模型逆向API【特长：长文本解读整理】，支持高速流式输出、智能体对话、联网搜索、探索版、K1思考模型、长文档解读、图像解析、多轮对话，零配置部署，多路token支持，自动清理会话痕迹，仅供测试，如需商用请前往官方开放平台。
repos.summary_zh: KIMI AI 长文本大模型逆向API，支持高速流式输出、多轮对话、联网搜索、智能体对话、长文档解读及图像解析，零配置部署，兼容ChatGPT接口，支持多路token轮询与自动会话清理，仅供测试用途。
repos.summary_en: KIMI AI long-text LLM reverse API supporting high-speed streaming, multi-turn dialogue, web search, agent conversations, document interpretation, and image parsing. Zero-config deployment, ChatGPT-compatible interface, multi-token support, and automatic session cleanup. For testing only.

repos.description: Use any LLMs (Large Language Models) for Deep Research. Support SSE API and MCP server.
repos.summary_zh: Deep Research 是一个基于 AI 的极速深度研究工具，支持多 LLM 模型（如 Gemini、OpenAI、Anthropic 等）和主流搜索引擎，可在约 2 分钟内生成高质量研究报告。采用 Thinking 与 Task 模型协同工作，支持本地知识库构建、知识图谱可视化、内容编辑与历史记录管理，所有数据均本地处理，保障隐私安全。
repos.summary_en: Deep Research is an AI-powered tool for lightning-fast in-depth research, supporting multiple LLMs (e.g., Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic) and search engines. It generates comprehensive reports in ~2 minutes using Thinking and Task models, with local knowledge base, knowledge graph, content editing, and full privacy via on-device processing.

repos.description: 拼多多、千牛、抖店 AI 客服机器人：自动回复客户咨询、商品答疑、售后申诉处理，支持微信、小红书、京东、抖音、B站、微博等多平台统一接待；可接入 DeepSeek / 通义千问 等大模型，支持自有知识库定制。
repos.summary_zh: 金销数据云智能客服是基于大语言模型的专业电商SaaS解决方案，支持微信、拼多多、千牛、抖音、小红书等10+主流平台接入，具备文本/语音/图片处理能力，支持自有知识库定制与插件扩展，提供多维度数据分析与意图识别功能。
repos.summary_en: JinXiao Data Cloud AI Customer Service is a professional e-commerce SaaS solution powered by large language models, supporting integration with 10+ mainstream platforms including WeChat, Pinduoduo, Qianniu, Douyin, Xiaohongshu, with capabilities for text/voice/image processing, custom knowledge base configuration, plugin ecosystem, and multi-dimensional data analytics including intent recognition.

repos.description: 基于LangChain和ChatGLM-6B等系列LLM的针对本地知识库的自动问答
repos.summary_zh: 本项目基于LangChain和ChatGLM-6B系列大模型，构建了一个针对本地知识库的自动问答Web应用。支持上传PDF、TXT、DOCX、MD等格式文档，结合多种Embedding模型实现语义检索，提供本地部署和云端体验，适用于私有知识问答、文档理解等场景。
repos.summary_en: This project builds a web-based QA system using LangChain and ChatGLM-6B series LLMs for local knowledge base queries. It supports uploading PDF, TXT, DOCX, MD files and integrates multiple embedding models for semantic retrieval, enabling private, offline document understanding and question answering.

repos.description: The simplest desktop client for OpenClaw 🦞 — bridge your Agent to WeChat, Feishu, Slack & Discord in one click. Works with Claude Code, Codex & any LLM. BYOK, Oauth, local-first, chat from your phone 24/7.
repos.summary_zh: nexu 是一款开源桌面客户端，专为 OpenClaw 🦞 设计，一键桥接 Agent 到微信、飞书、Slack 和 Discord。支持 Claude Code、Codex 等 LLM，采用 BYOK（自带密钥）、OAuth 认证及本地优先架构，实现全天候手机聊天。所有数据本地存储，隐私可控，提供图形化安装与多模型切换功能。
repos.summary_en: nexu is an open-source desktop client for OpenClaw 🦞 that bridges your AI agent to WeChat, Feishu, Slack, and Discord with one click. It works with Claude Code, Codex, and any LLM via BYOK, OAuth, and local-first architecture. Chat from your phone 24/7 with full privacy control—no vendor data routing. Features GUI setup, multi-model support (e.g., Gemini), and built-in IM integrations.

repos.description: Document (PDF, Word, PPTX ...) extraction and parse API using state of the art modern OCRs + Ollama supported models. Anonymize documents. Remove PII. Convert any document or picture to structured JSON or Markdown
repos.summary_zh: text-extract-api 是一个本地部署的文档提取与解析 API，支持 PDF、Word、PPT 和图片转换为高精度 Markdown 或结构化 JSON，集成 EasyOCR、Llama3.2-vision 等先进 OCR 模型及 Ollama 大模型，具备 PII 匿名化、分布式 Celery 队列处理、Redis 缓存等功能，无需依赖云端服务。
repos.summary_en: text-extract-api is a locally deployed document extraction and parsing API that converts images, PDFs, and Office documents into high-accuracy Markdown or structured JSON using advanced OCRs like EasyOCR and Llama3.2-vision, integrated with Ollama LLMs for text refinement and PII removal. It features distributed Celery processing, Redis caching, and no external cloud dependencies.

repos.description: 🚀 DeepSeek-V3 & R1大模型逆向API【特长：良心厂商】（官方贼便宜，建议直接走官方），支持高速流式输出、多轮对话，联网搜索，R1深度思考，零配置部署，多路token支持，仅供测试，如需商用请前往官方开放平台。
repos.summary_zh: 本项目提供 DeepSeek-V3 和 R1 大模型的逆向 API 接口，支持高速流式输出、多轮对话、联网搜索及深度思考功能，兼容 ChatGPT 接口标准，支持零配置部署与多账号 token 负载均衡，仅限个人测试使用，商用请转官方平台。
repos.summary_en: This project provides a reverse-engineered API for DeepSeek-V3 and R1 models, featuring high-speed streaming output, multi-turn conversations, web search, and deep reasoning. It is fully compatible with ChatGPT's API interface, supports zero-configuration deployment and multi-token load balancing, intended only for personal testing, commercial use requires official platform access.

repos.description: 开源免费的 Wispr Flow 替代方案 | 集成FunASR本地模型和可配置大语言模型的下一代中文桌面语音工作流
repos.summary_zh: 蛐蛐 (QuQu) 是一款开源免费的 Wispr Flow 替代方案，专为中文用户打造的桌面端智能语音工作流工具。集成阿里巴巴 FunASR 本地语音识别模型和可配置大语言模型，实现高精度中文识别与智能文本优化，支持隐私保护、国产 AI 模型适配及开发者友好功能，完全免费且跨平台。
repos.summary_en: QuQu is an open-source, free alternative to Wispr Flow, designed as a next-generation Chinese desktop voice workflow tool. It integrates Alibaba's FunASR local speech recognition model with configurable large language models, enabling high-precision Chinese transcription and intelligent text optimization. Features include privacy protection, support for domestic AI models, and developer-friendly formatting, all completely free and cross-platform.

repos.description: 将视频瞬间转化为手绘故事 Turn Video Moments into Hand-Drawn Stories
repos.summary_zh: ClipSketch AI 是一款专为视频创作者设计的 AI 驱动内容创作工具，支持解析 Bilibili 和小红书视频链接，实现帧级精准标记，并借助 Google Gemini 多模态模型将精彩瞬间一键转化为手绘风格故事板，自动生成适配社交媒体的爆款文案，涵盖角色融合、封面生成和批量精修功能。
repos.summary_en: ClipSketch AI is an AI-powered content creation tool for video creators, enabling frame-level tagging of Bilibili and Xiaohongshu videos, transforming key moments into hand-drawn storyboards via Google Gemini's multimodal models, and auto-generating social media captions, character fusion, cover images, and batch-enhanced visuals.

repos.description: 搜索真实文献并生成引用对应文献的AI论文
repos.summary_zh: paper-ai 是一个基于 AI 的论文写作工具，支持通过真实文献自动生成引用，集成 Semantic Scholar、arXiv 和 PubMed 进行文献检索，结合大模型生成高质量学术内容，显著提升论文撰写效率与引用准确性。
repos.summary_en: Paper-ai is an AI-powered academic writing tool that generates papers with real citations by searching Semantic Scholar, arXiv, and PubMed. It combines large language models with academic databases to streamline research and writing workflows.

repos.description: BrowserWing turns your browser actions into MCP commands Or Claude Skill, allowing AI agents to control browsers efficiently and reliably. Say goodbye to slow, token-heavy LLM interactions — let agents call commands directly for faster automation. Perfect for AI-driven tasks, browser automation, and boosting productivity.
repos.summary_zh: BrowserWing 是一款原生浏览器自动化平台，支持通过 MCP 协议和 Claude Skill 让 AI 智能体直接控制浏览器。提供 26+ HTTP API 接口、可视化脚本录制、LLM 驱动的数据提取及会话管理，实现高效可靠的浏览器自动化，显著减少 LLM 交互延迟。
repos.summary_en: BrowserWing is a native browser automation platform that enables AI agents to control browsers via MCP commands or Claude Skills. It offers 26+ HTTP APIs, visual script recording, LLM-powered data extraction, and session management for fast, reliable automation with minimal token overhead.

repos.description: 文档（小说、论文、字幕）翻译工具（支持 pdf/word/excel/json/epub/srt...）Document (Novel, Thesis, Subtitle) Translation Tool (Supports pdf/word/excel/json/epub/srt...)
repos.summary_zh: DocuTranslate 是一款基于大语言模型的本地文档翻译工具，支持 PDF、Word、Excel、JSON、EPUB、SRT 等多种格式。具备自动术语表生成、PDF 表格/公式/代码识别、JSON 路径翻译、格式保留、多 AI 平台支持、异步高并发处理、局域网多用户共享及交互式 Web 界面等功能。提供便携版安装包，适合小说、论文、字幕等场景的批量翻译。
repos.summary_en: DocuTranslate is a lightweight local document translation tool powered by Large Language Models. It supports multiple formats including PDF, Word, Excel, JSON, EPUB, and SRT. Features include automatic glossary generation, PDF table/formula/code recognition, JSON path-based translation, format preservation, multi-AI platform support, async concurrency, LAN multi-user access, and an integrated Web UI. Ideal for translating novels, academic papers, and subtitles with portable installers under 40MB.

repos.description: 🚀 MiniMax大模型海螺AI逆向API【特长：超自然语音】，支持MiniMax Text-01、MiniMax-VL-01模型，支持高速流式输出、语音合成、联网搜索、长文档解读、图像解析、多轮对话，零配置部署，多路token支持，自动清理会话痕迹，仅供测试，如需商用请前往官方开放平台。
repos.summary_zh: 本项目为MiniMax海螺AI提供逆向API服务，支持MiniMax-Text-01和MiniMax-VL-01模型，具备高速流式输出、语音合成与识别、联网搜索、长文档解读、图像解析及多轮对话能力。零配置部署，支持多路token并发，自动清理会话痕迹，接口兼容ChatGPT，适用于测试与个人使用。
repos.summary_en: This project provides a reverse-engineered API for MiniMax Hailuo AI, supporting MiniMax-Text-01 and MiniMax-VL-01 models. It features high-speed streaming output, speech synthesis/ASR, web search, document analysis, image parsing, and multi-turn conversations. Zero-configuration deployment, multi-token concurrency, session auto-cleanup, and full ChatGPT compatibility. For testing only; commercial use requires official platform access.

repos.description: 影子作家 · 为角色建立可复用的写作与语言特征模型，让 AI 稳定地「像某个人」说话。Python / Agent Skill 双形态。
repos.summary_zh: 本项目'ghostwriter'（影子作家）提供多来源语言特征JSON数据集，涵盖微博、文学影视角色及历史人物，支持非商业用途研究。采用CC BY-NC-ND 4.0许可，结合长上下文大模型可显著提升文本生成风格拟合度，适用于AI角色模拟与语言分析。
repos.summary_en: The 'ghostwriter' project provides structured linguistic feature datasets in JSON format, covering sources like Weibo, literary characters, and historical figures. Licensed under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 for non-commercial use, it enhances AI text generation when combined with large language models featuring long context capabilities, ideal for character simulation and stylistic analysis.

repos.description: ByeType 是一个 Markdown 驱动的 AI 语音输入工具，用多模态大模型直接处理原始音频（使用自己的APIKEY），编辑 Markdown 文件即可自定义专有词汇、转录规则和格式化策略，人名、术语、口水词、数字格式一次转录到位，减少二次修改。支持 macOS、Windows 和 iOS。
repos.summary_zh: ByeType 是一款基于 Markdown 提示词的 AI 语音输入工具，支持多模态大模型直接处理原始音频，实现专有词汇、术语、人名及数字格式的一次性精准转录，内置 AI 图像文字提取功能，可智能修复断行与还原代码结构，支持 macOS、Windows 和 iOS 平台，用户自备 API Key，数据直连服务商，安全高效。
repos.summary_en: ByeType is an AI-powered voice input tool driven by Markdown prompts, using multimodal LLMs to process raw audio directly for accurate transcription of names, jargon, and formatting in one pass. It includes AI-based text extraction from images, intelligently restoring broken lines and code structure. Supports macOS, Windows, and iOS with user-provided API keys for secure, direct cloud processing.

repos.description: An efficient API documentation management tool that fully adheres to the OpenAPI specification and incorporates advanced LLM technology. This tool can automate the generation of API documentation, data models, and test cases, greatly enhancing development efficiency and documentation quality.
repos.summary_zh: ApiCat 是一款高效 API 文档管理工具，完全遵循 OpenAPI 规范，集成先进 LLM 技术，可自动化生成 API 文档、数据模型和测试用例，显著提升开发效率与文档质量，支持本地部署与云端服务。
repos.summary_en: ApiCat is an efficient API documentation management tool fully compliant with the OpenAPI specification. It leverages advanced LLM technology to automate API documentation, data model, and test case generation, significantly enhancing development efficiency and documentation quality. Supports local deployment and cloud services.

repos.description: 轻量级的clawdbot/openclaw，支持飞书，钉钉，QQ和企业微信
repos.summary_zh: OpenMozi 是一个轻量级、专注国产生态的 AI 助手框架，支持 DeepSeek、豆包、通义千问等国产大模型及 OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容接口，提供统一的 Function Calling 能力。它原生集成 QQ、飞书、钉钉、企业微信等通讯平台适配器，内置 25 个工具（文件操作、浏览器自动化、定时任务等）、记忆系统、Skills 技能扩展机制，以及智能上下文压缩策略，适用于企业内部机器人和团队协作场景。
repos.summary_en: OpenMozi is a lightweight AI assistant framework focused on the Chinese ecosystem, supporting domestic LLMs like DeepSeek, Doubao, and Qwen via unified OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible interfaces with native Function Calling. It integrates adapters for QQ, Feishu, DingTalk, and WeCom, featuring 25 built-in tools (file ops, browser automation, cron jobs), memory system, Skills extension via SKILL.md, and intelligent context compression—ideal for enterprise bots and team collaboration.

repos.description: 轻量级的clawdbot/openclaw，支持飞书，钉钉，QQ和企业微信
repos.summary_zh: OpenMozi 是一个轻量级 AI 助手框架，专为国产生态设计，支持 DeepSeek、豆包、Qwen 等国产大模型及 OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容接口，提供飞书、钉钉、QQ、企业微信等多平台机器人接入，具备 Function Calling、25 个内置工具、记忆系统、定时任务等核心功能，代码简洁（约1.6万行），适合学习 Agent 原理和快速开发企业级智能助手。
repos.summary_en: OpenMozi is a lightweight AI assistant framework designed for the Chinese ecosystem, supporting domestic LLMs like DeepSeek, Doubao, Qwen, and OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible APIs. It offers multi-platform bot integration (Feishu, DingTalk, QQ, WeCom), native Function Calling, 25 built-in tools, memory system, cron jobs, and a skill-based architecture. With ~16K lines of clean code, it's ideal for learning agent principles and rapid development of enterprise-grade AI assistants.

repos.description: 一款跨平台智能笔记 Agent 应用，支持多格式笔记、本地知识库、AI 智能助手、向量语义检索 。
repos.summary_zh: OpenNote 是一款跨平台智能笔记 Agent 应用，支持多格式笔记管理、本地知识库构建、AI 智能助手及向量语义检索。具备长期记忆与自我进化能力，通过 MCP 协议与 AI 大模型深度集成，实现知识的高效组织与智能问答，适合个人知识管理与 AI 增强型笔记场景。
repos.summary_en: OpenNote is a cross-platform intelligent note-taking Agent application that supports multi-format note management, local knowledge base building, AI-powered assistance, and vector semantic search. With long-term memory and self-evolving capabilities, it integrates deeply with AI large language models via the MCP protocol, enabling efficient knowledge organization and intelligent Q&A for personal knowledge management and AI-enhanced note-taking scenarios.

repos.description: Generate SQL query from natural language.
repos.summary_zh: GenQL 是一款将自然语言转换为 SQL 查询的工具，基于 Pinecone 向量数据库和 OpenAI 大模型技术，支持数据库模式索引、语音输入、查询历史记录等功能，适用于数据分析、应用开发和团队协作等场景，显著提升非技术用户与数据库交互的效率。
repos.summary_en: GenQL is a natural language to SQL translation tool powered by Pinecone vector database and OpenAI LLM, enabling schema indexing, voice input, and query history. It streamlines database interactions for data analysts, developers, and non-technical users, enhancing productivity in reporting, exploration, and app development.
